description: Use when you want the L3 residual mean-reversion signal aggregated over a basket of 1-100 stocks. Not for the residual return series themselves (use riskmodels_get_residual_returns). Returns, from POST /signals/residual-reversion/basket, the basket-aggregated signal, with optional weights and a minimum signal-quality quintile; it describes recent residual moves and is not a forecast. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.02 per call.

signal_quality_min_quintile.description: Drop names below this signal-quality quintile, integer 1-5, e.g. 3

weights.description: Weights aligned to tickers, decimals, e.g. [0.5,0.3,0.2] (default equal weight)

name: riskmodels_get_residual_signal
title: RiskModels Residual Mean-Reversion Signal
